CR has also been shown to increase resistance to stress and toxicity, and maintain youthful levels of function and vitality in laboratory mammals at advanced chronological age [7]. CR in rhesus monkeys have produced physiological responses strikingly similar to those observed in rodents and delayed the onset of age-related diseases, but effects on longevity were not consistent [8]. Data from these studies indicate that long-term CR reduces morbidity and mortality in primates, and thus may exert beneficial ‘antiaging' effects in humans.
